purpose: Preserve the making-history of artifacts: weird turns, jokes, accidental names, corrections, discoveries and compact human/AI exchanges that explain how a thing actually emerged.
laws: CURATE, DO NOT DUMP CHAT LOGS
A FUNNY MOMENT MAY STILL BE A DESIGN DONOR
DO NOT PUBLISH OTHER PEOPLE'S PRIVATE WORDS WITHOUT AUTHORITY
projection: A scrolling conversational marginalia layer beside/behind an artifact, not the artifact's primary interface.
promotion_rule: Only curated entries explicitly marked PUBLIC_CURATED may enter a public artifact history.
